title: Miami facts that sound fake
igCaption:
Miami facts that sound fake… but every one is real 🤯

Founded by a woman, gators AND crocs, a one-man coral castle, houses in the middle of the bay, a pool in a quarry, a park that's 95% water.

Which one did you not know? 👇

#Miami #MiamiFacts #SouthFlorida #Florida

scenes.text: These Miami facts sound fake. But every single one is real. Number four is crazy.
scenes.caption: These Miami facts sound fake. But every single one is real. Number four is crazy.

scenes.text: Miami is the only major American city founded by a woman. Her name was Julia Tuttle. She convinced Henry Flagler to bring his railroad south.
scenes.caption: Miami is the only major American city founded by a woman. Her name was Julia Tuttle. She convinced Henry Flagler to bring his railroad south.

scenes.text: South Florida is the only place on Earth where alligators and crocodiles live side by side. Both live in the Everglades.
scenes.caption: South Florida is the only place on Earth where alligators and crocodiles live side by side. Both live in the Everglades.

scenes.text: One man built Coral Castle by himself. Edward Leedskalnin carved more than a thousand tons of coral rock. He worked at night, and never let anyone watch.
scenes.caption: One man built Coral Castle by himself. Edward Leedskalnin carved more than a thousand tons of coral rock. He worked at night, and never let anyone watch.

scenes.text: There are houses standing on stilts in the middle of Biscayne Bay. It's called Stiltsville. Seven of them are still standing today.
scenes.caption: There are houses standing on stilts in the middle of Biscayne Bay. It's called Stiltsville. Seven of them are still standing today.

scenes.text: The Venetian Pool in Coral Gables was built inside an old coral rock quarry. It's filled with fresh water from an underground aquifer.
scenes.caption: The Venetian Pool in Coral Gables was built inside an old coral rock quarry. It's filled with fresh water from an underground aquifer.

scenes.text: Biscayne National Park is about ninety-five percent water. Most of the park is underwater.
scenes.caption: Biscayne National Park is about 95% water. Most of the park is underwater.
